Notes: Unigine Heaven Benchmark 4.0. Launcher exe is PE32; engine is Unigine_x86.dll. D3D11 loaded via LoadLibrary at runtime (no static import) — proxy d3d11.dll sits in bin/ next to Heaven.exe.

DeviceCreation.SwapChainCreatedBy: IDXGIFactory::CreateSwapChain (NOT D3D11CreateDeviceAndSwapChain) — hook factory vtable in Phase 3 via device->QueryInterface(IDXGIDevice)->GetAdapter->GetParent(IDXGIFactory)

Recon.Method: in-proxy CB dump via hkUpdateSubresource + hkVSSetConstantBuffers (Heaven uses UpdateSubresource for CBs, not Map)
Recon.ProjectionCB: 144-byte CB bound at VS slot 0; float[0..15] = perspective proj m00=0.9743 m11=1.7321(f=sqrt3) m22=-1 m23=-1 m32=-0.3 (zn=0.3, far~inf, RH D3D row-major); tail read as NaN (packed/partially-unwritten tail)
Recon.UICB: 64-byte CB also at VS slot 0 during GUI pass; ortho 2/1280=0.0016, -2/720=-0.0028 — SkipDrawIf.orthographic heuristic must look at matrix contents, not slot alone
VertexLayouts: num=3 stride=32: POSITION f32x3 @0, TEXCOORD0 f32x4 @12, COLOR0 u8x4n @28
num=4 stride=64: POSITION f32x3 @0, TEXCOORD0-2 f32x4 @16/32/48 (likely full mesh: pos + packed normal/tangent/uv)
num=6 stride=48: POSITION f32x2 @0, TEXCOORD0-4 f16x4 @8..40 (packed/UI)
num=2 stride=16: POSITION f32x3 @0, TEXCOORD0 u8x4n @12

Perf.Note: Values here are documentation; the proxy only reads retro.json next to d3d11.dll.
Perf.RenderScaleNote: works since the proxy shrinks the swap-chain backbuffer itself (real buffer 320x180, believed 1280x720, stretched at present) — keeps Unigine's texel-Load() post chain consistent. Earlier RT-only scaling blacked the screen.

Neural.Note: Mode "Neural" — ORT 1.22.1 DirectML EP (last NuGet with win-x86) + DirectML 1.15.4. onnxruntime.dll/DirectML.dll/retro_ai*.onnx deployed to bin/. Needs x86 VC++ runtime (SysWOW64).
Neural.AiWidthHeightNote: RenderScale 4 on 1280x720 -> real backbuffer 320x180 = model input [1,3,180,320]
Neural.AiTemporalNote: 1 = lerp with previous output (AiBlend); 2 = AiModel must be the two-input retro_ai_temporal.onnx
